description: Build a canonical atlas of known 42-vertex frontier colorings together with orbit-distinct 42 -> 43 extension failures. The target object is a small reusable dictionary of minimal obstruction cores rather than another low-defect witness search.
mathematical_formalization: Given parent colorings G_i on 42 vertices and orbit classes E_i of one-vertex extensions, learn a map phi: union_i E_i -> C where C is a small set of canonical obstruction cores minimizing |C| subject to witness completeness.
implementation_hypothesis: Canonicalize parents by automorphism data, enumerate orbit-distinct extensions, extract minimal red/blue K5-forcing patterns, and cluster them across parent families.
experiment_seed: Use the saved Exoo/Ge/Lehavi line as the initial parent set and measure how many failed extensions are covered by the top-k cores.

closest_prior_art.title: Study of Exoo's Lower Bound for Ramsey number R(5,5)
Ramsey Number Counterexample Checking and One Vertex Extension Linearly Bound by s and t

novelty_claim: The novelty is a transfer-tested obstruction library that can serve both lower-bound pruning and upper-bound lemma generation.
differentiation: This is not a nicer search engine. It claims a reusable Ramsey object that persists across parent families.
